pack_name: Medieval Western Feudal & Chivalric World: Lãnh Địa Phong Kiến & Hiệp Sĩ
vietnamese_title: Gói Tài Nguyên Thế Giới Trung Cổ Phương Tây: Lãnh Địa Phong Kiến & Hiệp Sĩ
world_tier: Western Feudal Realm (Trung Cổ Phương Tây)
art_style: 2D Orthographic top-down (~45 degrees), gouache hand-painted, ink contour lines (#263A35), European medieval palette (ashlar limestone #8A8D8F, slate blue #4A5568, oak timber #5C4033, heraldic vermilion #9B2C2C, royal azure #2B6CB0, lion gold #D69E2E, thatch straw #C7A75C).

categories.name: Anglo-Norman Feudal Heartland
categories.vietnamese_name: Trọng Tâm Phong Kiến Anglo-Norman
categories.description: Motte-and-bailey timber stockades, square keeps, Norman chevron arch carvings, heavy oak halls, chivalric court seats.

categories.name: Hanseatic & Flemish Burgher Town
categories.vietnamese_name: Đô Thị Phường Hội Hanseatic & Flanders
categories.description: Backsteingotik red-brick stepped gables, canal lock gates, cloth halls, weighing houses (Waag), guild counting houses, leaded bay windows.

categories.name: Nordic & Norse Coastal Settlement
categories.vietnamese_name: Khu Định Cư Ven Biển Bắc Âu & Norse
categories.description: Turf-roofed longhouses, dragon-carved stave pillars, runic memorial stones, boathouses (naust), whalebone arches, drying cod racks.

categories.name: Mediterranean & Moorish Quarter
categories.vietnamese_name: Khu Phố Địa Trung Hải & Moorish (Al-Andalus)
categories.description: Arcaded cool courtyards (patios), azulejo glazed tile fountains, terracotta tiled roofs, olive oil presses, spice souks, whitewashed stucco walls.

categories.name: Slavic Eastern Taiga & Logcraft
categories.vietnamese_name: Làng Gỗ Rừng Taiga Đông Slav (Kievan Rus)
categories.description: Interlocking round-log cabins (izbas), wooden kremlins (gorodishche), carved window frames (nalichniki), onion-domed timber chapels, fur-trading posts.

categories.name: Celtic Highland & Atlantic Fringe
categories.vietnamese_name: Vùng Cao Nguyên & Rìa Đại Tây Dương Celtic
categories.description: Drystone broch towers, lake crannogs, turf beehive huts (clochán), high Celtic wheel crosses, peat fire hearths, holy wells with votive ribbons.

categories.name: Byzantine & Crusader Outposts
categories.vietnamese_name: Tiền Đồn Byzantine & Thập Tự Quân
categories.description: Rough limestone border watchtowers with stone hoardings, Byzantine brick-mortar layers, orthodox roadside icon shrines, caravanserai courtyards.

categories.name: Wayfarers, Nomads & Tinker Camps
categories.vietnamese_name: Khu Cắm Trại Dân Du Mục & Thợ Hàn Nồi
categories.description: Barrel-top wooden vardo wagons, horse tether lines, tinker metalwork bellows, campfire fiddles, fortune-telling tapestries, wanderer canvas lean-tos.

categories.name: Modular Timber-Frame (Fachwerk)
categories.vietnamese_name: Kiến Trúc Khung Gỗ Fachwerk Lắp Ghép
categories.description: European half-timbering: cruck frames, jetty bays, wattle-daub, leaded diamond windows, thatch eaves, clay tile gables, dormers.

categories.name: Village Cottages & Serf Hovels
categories.vietnamese_name: Nhà Tranh Thôn Xóm & Túp Lều Nông Nô
categories.description: Peasant turf huts, smoke-hole thatch hovels, mud-cob walls, outdoor clay bread ovens, drystone dykes, dog kennels, woodpiles.

categories.name: Castles, Curtain Walls & Bastions
categories.vietnamese_name: Lâu Đài, Tường Thành Đá & Pháo Đài
categories.description: Ashlar curtain walls, sloped talus bases, battlements, machicolation overhangs, drum bastions, barbicans, portcullises, murder holes, moats.

categories.name: Palace Keeps & Royal Chambers
categories.vietnamese_name: Đại Điện Cung Điện & Phòng Hoàng Gia
categories.description: Carved oak thrones, feasting trestle tables, heraldic tapestries, monumental fireplaces, four-poster canopy beds, chancery scriptoria.

categories.name: Garrisons, Barracks & Watchtowers
categories.vietnamese_name: Doanh Trại Đồn Trú & Tháp Canh Biên Giới
categories.description: Border stone watchtowers, garrison bunkhouses, armory weapon racks, archery shooting butts, signal beacon fire baskets.

categories.name: City Gates, Bridges & Portals
categories.vietnamese_name: Cổng Thành, Cầu Đá & Trạm Thu Phí
categories.description: Twin-towered town gates, toll booths, curfew bell towers, Norman stone barrel-arch bridges, timber ox-cart trestles, river fords.

categories.name: Gothic Cathedrals & Monumental Abbeys
categories.vietnamese_name: Đại Giáo Đường Gothic & Tu Viện Kỳ Vĩ
categories.description: Pointed arch portals, carved tympanums, flying buttresses, rose stained glass windows, high marble altars, choir stalls, reliquary chasses.

categories.name: Monasteries, Cloisters & Scriptoria
categories.vietnamese_name: Hành Lang Tu Viện & Phòng Chép Kinh
categories.description: Arcaded cloister walks, lavabo fountains, scriptorium manuscript desks, herb drying ceiling racks, refectory tables, monk cell cots.

categories.name: Parish Chapels & Wayside Shrines
categories.vietnamese_name: Nhà Nguyện Giáo Xứ & Miếu Thờ Ven Đường
categories.description: Village stone chapels, thatched hermit huts, roadside Madonna shrines, holy wellsprings, penitent stone prayer benches.

categories.name: Graveyards, Crypts & Charnel Houses
categories.vietnamese_name: Nghĩa Trang, Hầm Mộ & Nhà Chứa Xương
categories.description: Slate headstones, Celtic wheel crosses, knightly effigy sarcophagi (gisants), charnel house skull walls, weeping yew trees, lychgates.

categories.name: Medieval Alchemy & Natural Philosophy
categories.vietnamese_name: Giả Kim Thuật & Triết Học Tự Nhiên
categories.description: Athanor slow-combustion ovens, glass alembics, retorts, brass armillary spheres, dried mandrake roots, celestial star charts.

categories.name: Witchcraft, Folklore & Bog Magic
categories.vietnamese_name: Phù Thủy, Phong Tục Dân Gian & Phép Đầm Lầy
categories.description: Peat bog witch stilt huts, boiling iron cauldrons, animal skull charms, wicker effigies, cursed fairy rings, protective hex marks.

categories.name: Plague Lazarettos & Quarantine
categories.vietnamese_name: Trại Phong Hủi & Khu Cách Ly Dịch Bệnh
categories.description: Leper isolation wards, warning wooden clappers, plague quarantine chalk door crosses, aromatic herb burning pans, mass burial pits.

categories.name: Grain Agriculture & Harvesting
categories.vietnamese_name: Canh Tác Lúa Mì & Thu Hoạch Mùa Màng
categories.description: Ridge-and-furrow wheat plots, barley rows, heavy wheeled moldboard plows, scythes, sickles, wheat sheaves, conical hayricks.

categories.name: Pastoralism, Livestock & Dairy
categories.vietnamese_name: Chăn Thả Gia Súc & Chế Biến Bơ Sữa
categories.description: Hillside drystone sheepfolds, cattle feeding mangers, sheep shearing trestles, pig wallow pens, straw bee skeps, dairy butter churns.

categories.name: Orchards, Vineyards & Brewing
categories.vietnamese_name: Vườn Cây Ăn Trái, Vườn Nho & Lò Nấu Rượu
categories.description: Apple espaliers, grape trellises, wooden screw wine presses, copper mash tuns, fermenting vats, stacked oak beer hogsheads.

categories.name: Watermills, Windmills & Milling
categories.vietnamese_name: Cối Xay Nước, Cối Xay Gió & Xay Xát
categories.description: Overshot waterwheels, millraces, sluice gates, canvas-rigged post windmills, granite millstones in octagonal casings.

categories.name: Blacksmithing & Metal Refining
categories.vietnamese_name: Rèn Đúc Sắt Thép & Tinh Luyện Kim Loại
categories.description: Hearth forges with leather bellows, heavy anvils, quench troughs, swage blocks, iron bloomery smelters, charcoal burner mounds.

categories.name: Forestry, Timber & Cooperage
categories.vietnamese_name: Lâm Nghiệp, Xẻ Gỗ & Đóng Thùng
categories.description: Sawpit trenches with two-man saws, shaving horses, cooper barrel-trussing braziers, iron barrel hoops, seasoning lumber stacks.

categories.name: Wool, Textile & Dyeing Guilds
categories.vietnamese_name: Phường Hội Dệt Nỉ, Nhuộm Màu & Kéo Sợi
categories.description: Drop spindles, horizontal treadle looms, woad/madder dye vats, tenter field drying frames, water-powered fulling stocks.

categories.name: Tannery, Leatherwork & Cordwaining
categories.vietnamese_name: Thuộc Da, Đóng Giày & Thuộc Bằng Vỏ Cây
categories.description: Oak-bark tanning pits, fleshing beams, hide stretching frames, lime slaking pits, cobbler lasts, leather currying tables.

categories.name: Pottery, Glassblowing & Masonry
categories.vietnamese_name: Gốm Sứ, Thổi Thủy Tinh & Đẽo Đá
categories.description: Kick-wheel benches, beehive brick kilns, glassblower annealing furnaces, stonecutter banker benches, treadwheel lifting cranes.

categories.name: Mining, Quarries & Lime Kilns
categories.vietnamese_name: Khai Mỏ, Mỏ Đá & Lò Nung Vôi
categories.description: Open limestone quarry faces, timber-shored mine adits, wooden ore carts, mine drainage troughs, calcining lime kilns.

categories.name: Urban Street Markets & Civic Life
categories.vietnamese_name: Chợ Đường Phố & Đời Sống Dân Cư Đô Thị
categories.description: Striped canvas market booths, public steelyard scales, town market crosses, town hall noticeboards, pillories, foot stocks.

categories.name: Taverns, Coaching Inns & Alehouses
categories.vietnamese_name: Quán Rượu, Trạm Cỗ Xe & Quán Bia Cỏ
categories.description: Heavy oak bar counters, pewter mugs, central roast hearths, gaming tables (dice & cards), horse coaching stables, straw sleeping lofts.

categories.name: Harbors, Quays & Hanseatic Cogs
categories.vietnamese_name: Bến Cảng, Bờ Kè & Thuyền Buồm Cog
categories.description: Heavy oak timber quays, stone breakwaters, Hanseatic cogs, river punts, treadwheel harbor cranes, herring salting barrels, tollhouses.

categories.name: River Fisheries, Waterways & Ferries
categories.vietnamese_name: Nghề Cá Sông, Kênh Đào & Phà Bến Nước
categories.description: Clinker fishing rowboats, fish-drying nets, reed fish weirs, cable ferry landings, river toll booms, boathouse sheds.

categories.name: Fairs, Festivals & Carnivals
categories.vietnamese_name: Hội Chợ, Lễ Hội Mùa & Diễn Xướng
categories.description: Pageant miracle play wagons, puppet stages, flower-wound Maypoles, roasted whole ox spits, heraldic tournament lists, juggler props.

categories.name: Knighthood, Tournaments & Chivalry
categories.vietnamese_name: Đấu Thương Hiệp Sĩ & Tinh Thần Thượng Võ
categories.description: Jousting tilt barriers, velvet royal viewing boxes, rotating quintains, weapon racks, knightly heraldic pavilions.

categories.name: Siege Engines & Heavy Artillery
categories.vietnamese_name: Máy Bắn Đá, Vũ Khí Công Thành & Đột Kích
categories.description: Counterweight trebuchets, heavy ballistas, covered battering rams, mangonels, wheeled mantlets (pavises), siege trenches.

categories.name: Military Camps & Field Works
categories.vietnamese_name: Doanh Trại Quân Sự & Công Sự Dã Ngoại
categories.description: Conical canvas bell tents, officer marquees, camp cook cauldrons, weapon pyramids, chevaux-de-frise cavalry barriers, wicker gabions.

categories.name: Battlefield Aftermath & Ruins
categories.vietnamese_name: Chiến Trường Tàn Tích & Dấu Vết Bại Trận
categories.description: Smashed wagons, stuck crossbow bolts, charred earth craters, tattered heraldic banners, broken polearms, open looting pits.

categories.name: Outlaws, Bandits & Dungeon Depths
categories.vietnamese_name: Sơn Tặc, Ngục Tối & Lòng Đất Hắc Ám
categories.description: Brushwood lean-tos, pitfall traps, roadside gallows, iron gibbets, hollow-tree caches, iron maiden, wall manacles, oubliette grates.

categories.name: Primeval Forests, Ancient Oaks & Woods
categories.vietnamese_name: Rừng Nguyên Sinh, Sồi Cổ Thụ & Dẻ Gai
categories.description: Gnarled Sherwood oaks, towering beeches, Scots pines, bracken ferns, wild blackberry brambles, hollow nurse logs, fairy rings.

categories.name: Cliffs, Highland Moors & Waterfalls
categories.vietnamese_name: Vách Đá Vôi, Cao Nguyên Than Bùn & Thác Nước
categories.description: Stratified limestone cliffs, granite tors, dark cavern mouths, purple heather moors, rushing waterfall drops, scree slopes.

categories.name: Wetlands, Bogs, Fens & Marshlands
categories.vietnamese_name: Đầm Lầy Than Bùn, Bãi Sậy & Nước Chua
categories.description: Spongy sphagnum peat bogs, dark fen sludge, willow carrs, cattail marshes, water iris clumps, peat cutting trenches.

categories.name: Living Ground, Pavements & Tracks
categories.vietnamese_name: Mặt Đất Đời Sống, Lối Đi & Vết Bánh Xe
categories.description: Roman paved highways, sunken holloways, cobblestone pavements, deep muddy cart ruts, puddle reflections, autumn leaf carpets, rime frost.

categories.name: Domesticity, Chores & Habitation Traces
categories.vietnamese_name: Đời Sống Gia Đình, Việc Nhà & Dấu Vết Sinh Hoạt
categories.description: Hanging laundry lines, steaming cow dung heaps, butter churns, wash tubs, chimney smoke drifts, chamberpot slops.

categories.name: Wildlife, Micro-Fauna, Birds & Pests
categories.vietnamese_name: Động Vật Hoang Dã, Chim Muông & Thú Nhỏ
categories.description: Stork nests atop thatched chimneys, swallow barn nests, barn cats stalking mice, stray tavern curs, roosting pigeons, gallows crows.

categories.name: Denizens, Burghers, Peasants & Beasts
categories.vietnamese_name: Cư Dân, Thị Dân, Nông Dân & Súc Vật Kéo
categories.description: Serfs, milkmaids, blacksmiths, monks, friars, town watchmen, armored knights, highwaymen, heavy shire draft horses, oxen, sheep flocks.
